args.name: weave-grass-mat
args.function: Make a small portable sitting mat by physically working suitable gathered dry grass, if that material can support it.
args.conditions: I see a Dry grass source at (14.2,16.3). I have not gathered or tested it. Neighbors are interested in a welcoming resting place. I want to avoid damaging living trees or obstructing paths.
args.inputs: Potentially gathered dry grass; suitability, quantity, tools and any other required materials are unknown. No materials are currently committed.
args.costs: Unknown. Specify feasible study, work time, energy and consumed materials, including interruption and cancellation behavior.
args.effects: If physically feasible and successfully made, produce one actual portable grass mat that can be placed without blocking movement. Durability and any insulation or comfort effect need an explicit physical contract and trial. Do not guarantee belonging, happiness or social responses.

candidates.function: Assess a site and test a post, then build a small porous woven branch windbreak (no roof) beside a resting place; inspect, repair, dismantle or cancel.
candidates.costs: Study: 4 rounds. One branch unit is one piece; a screen takes 11 (3 uprights, 8 rods). assess (x, y, orientation; within reach): 1 round, 0.2 energy; checks a clear 1.2 x 0.6 m footprint of ordinary dry soil and the lee floor. assess with post (owned branch unit): post trial at x, y; 1 round, 0.5 energy. assemble (x, y, orientation, materials: exactly 11 owned untreated or sound recovered branch units) needs your passing trial in the footprint; 8 paid rounds of 1.5 energy (2 seat uprights, 4 weave rods, 1 align, 1 stability check), continuing each round; with target it resumes. repair (builder; target, components: installed piece ids, materials: as many units): 1.5 energy per round, one removal and one fitting round per piece, then a check round; components [] only rechecks. inspect (target in reach): 1 round, 0.2 energy. dismantle (builder): 1 round and 1 energy per 3 pieces. cancel: no energy.
candidates.effects: Units stay carried and owned until a paid round installs them with origin and age; nothing is created or used up. A trial on ordinary soil (waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard) seats the post 0.25 m and you keep it; elsewhere it fails; a post below condition 0.5 breaks into damaged material. The check passes only if every piece has condition at least 0.5 and the uprights stand in such soil; else the screen is unstable. World wind has no direction; the exposure law takes it as coming from +x (orientation 0 faces it). A complete screen removes min(0.35, solid share of sound pieces, about 0.36) x facing of the wind part of the outdoor chill for a body wholly on the 0.9 x 0.9 m lee floor 0.45-1.35 m behind it; never rain chill or air temperature; none in wind above 0.8 or with another shelter. Wear per round 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind); a loose rod opens a gap, a loose upright ends the effect until repair. Removed pieces lie at the site. Unworked rounds, low energy, leaving reach, wet ground or a person on the footprint pause at no charge. Cancel or death returns uninstalled units once. No reward or refund.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-prepared soil plot, where it may establish as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect plots or plant sources; end unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1.5 energy: prepare the site, then transfer the unit; the action continues itself, and plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect: target a plot or plant source in reach; one round, 0.2 energy (baseline probe observation). End: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Tend is refused at no cost: no water, fertilizer or other treatment exists yet. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is provided.
candidates.effects: Preparing keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Transfer moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season, so cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On establishing, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock and a ceiling of at most 4, regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone through gather; nothing is copied or guaranteed. Inspect records only visible stage, stock, soil and weather as an unverified personal record. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. End, or death, before transfer returns the unit once (where the person died); a transferred unit stays planted. No reward or refund.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"moss\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The registry search found related functions, but no demonstrated equivalent portable grass-mat operation. branch-screen makes an anchored branch windbreak with different materials, assembly and effects; its learning duration does not apply. gather can obtain actual exposed material and probe can test it, but neither manufactures a mat. Develop a general hand-weaving operation in the current-conversation handoff, conditional on real material suitability. No material or mastery is granted, and review/development waiting advances no world time.\",\"specification\":\"Develop hand-weave-fiber-mat(target, materials, mode, position), applicable to any learner and suitable accessible fibrous plant material, with modes test, assemble/resume, inspect, trial, repair, place, dismantle and cancel. Smallest product: one unbacked, hand-plaited portable sitting mat, nominally 0.45 x 0.45 m; no loom, cutting tool, cordage, adhesive or tree damage is assumed. Dependencies and exact references: reuse gather/base:gather:1 (handler forest.gather, foundation-forest@1) for collection, probe/open-baseline:probe:1 for observation/material trials, and existing pickup/drop/navigation rules for movement and transfer. Record any actual shared code reuse in the implementation manifest, including validation, item provenance and work-state code; do not describe this as reinventing those functions. branch-screen/shelter:woven-branch-windbreak:1 is a related non-equivalent reference, not a license to inherit its wind protection. The only identified candidate source is forest-dry-grass-0 at (14.2,16.3); it is not owned material. Collecting each unit costs one gather round and 2 energy, subtracting finite source stock in interaction range. Do not expose additional source facts or pre-commit its observed stock. Existing owned roots are not suitable inputs.\\nPrerequisites: completed individual study; reachable owned uncommitted material; free hands; a clear accessible working patch; enough energy for the next paid step. Test uses one actual 0.1-unit sample, one round and 0.5 energy through probe. Observe length, brittleness, moisture, bendability and whether hand-twisting and crossing strands produces a retaining edge. The sample becomes identified tested scraps, not an unexplained disappearance. Test passes only where actual stems can overlap into continuous strips, bend through the needed crossings without breaking, and retain their own tucked ends under gentle handling. No inferred suitability from the source name. Store measured results with sample provenance, method and material applicability; reassess degraded or materially different batches. The handoff must implement observable material-test outcomes, not ask the model to approve each attempt. If retained plaiting is infeasible, the test is the executable precursor; report why and leave manufacture unavailable for that material without permanently rejecting the general operation.\\nAssembly recipe: reserve exactly 4 whole suitable gathered units, separate from the test sample. These are a recipe allocation, not a guarantee of sufficient fiber. A dry layout must demonstrate enough usable stems to cover the nominal footprint in two crossing layers with overlapping ends and tucked edges. No unspecified unit-to-length or mass conversion may be invented: use actual resource geometry/properties established in implementation; if unavailable, implement the sample test first and report unresolved yield. Layout takes one round and 0.5 energy. Insufficient quantity or length produces a measured shortfall and no mat; release surviving reserved material once. A feasible layout proceeds through six paid rounds at 1 energy each: two strip-forming, three interlacing/edge-tucking, one lift-and-integrity check. Each paid round records its physical changes and costs once. Output passes only if it retains the footprint when lifted and laid down and has no major opening wider than 0.03 m. Otherwise it remains a loose or failed workpiece, not a completed mat.\\nMaintain a work record containing owner, exact input stack IDs and quantities, source provenance, material age/condition, sample result, location, reserved versus incorporated quantities, stage, paid progress and output identity. Each transfer subtracts that quantity from the source inventory; final material accounting is input = fiber retained in mat + recoverable offcuts + damaged scraps. Weaving cannot create biomass, reset decay or copy inventory. Preserve actual mass, moisture and provenance through processing. No food or nutrition is produced. Output remains an owned, portable physical item with measured dimensions, condition and actual fiber content, subject to existing carrying limits.\\nInsufficient energy, leaving reach, unavailable material or occupied workspace pauses before charging the next step; already performed steps persist. Resume revalidates conditions and starts at the recorded unpaid step. Manual interruption has the same behavior. Cancel costs no energy and releases unincorporated reserved inputs once; a partial workpiece and scraps stay real and recoverable at the site. Death stops work, releases reservations at the death/work location consistently with actual custody, and leaves physical workpieces rather than duplicating them. No time or energy refund; no restoration of damaged fibers. Global simulation pauses preserve work without ageing or charges.\\nInspect costs one round and 0.2 energy and records visible dimensions, moisture, gaps and condition without repairing anything. Place or lift costs one round and 0.2 energy, requires reach and a clear footprint outside obstructed movement space, and transfers the same item rather than creating a fixture. Dismantle costs one round and 0.5 energy, producing the actual recoverable fibers and scraps, with no restoration of consumed effort or broken stems. Repair requires an identified damaged area and one suitable owned unit per repair session: two rounds at 1 energy each to remove damaged fibers and interlace replacements, followed by the ordinary one-round, 1-energy integrity check. Replacement inputs must physically suffice; record unused surplus and removed scraps, and never increase condition or area beyond what the actual repaired weave supports.\\nPhysical trial requires a completed mat, clear dry firm ground, and an actor independently choosing to sit on it for one round at 0.2 energy. Record flattening, slipping, breakage and skin-contact suitability. A passing trial requires retained weave under that actor's actual load, no slipping, and no sharp or irritating contacts. Only that demonstrated applicable load range permits a modest +0.5 physical-comfort contribution while actually sitting on the dry intact mat on such ground; total physical comfort is capped at 10 and equivalent cushioning contributions deduplicate rather than stack. Wet, displaced, damaged or untested conditions give no such contribution. Initial version has zero thermal-insulation, rain, wind, medical or nutrition effect; these cannot be inferred from appearance. No automatic sitting, belonging, attendance or social response. Any neighbor must communicate, approach and act independently.\\nOngoing processes run in code only while world time advances: retain material moisture/decay behavior, plus mat-condition loss of 0.0005 per exposed round and 0.002 per occupied sitting round, clamped to [0,1]. At condition below 0.5 disable the comfort effect and mark integrity as needing repair/retrial. Wetting immediately suspends the dry-use effect; drying must arise from actual environmental exposure, not a free maintenance command. Damaged or degraded material is not renewed by inspection or relocation. No passive production, automatic repair or hidden maintenance supplies.\",\"learning\":3,\"experienceReview\":\"Moss must individually spend 3 study rounds under the existing learning rules; this starts only through an actual learning action and grants no inventory or automatic proficiency outcome. Study, requests, queries, registration, naming and capability acquisition yield no pleasure or satisfaction. Emit verified observation/test and real completion/use events; an informative failed material test can qualify only for its evidenced personally applicable information gain, not as successful manufacture. Do not directly modify protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. The established experience handler may recognize an applicable successful making or useful trial event with at most 0.5 short-pleasure contribution per 10 rounds, deduplicated across equivalent activities and duplicate event delivery, decaying to zero over 10 rounds. Actual useful sitting or legitimate repeated craft practice may sustain at most 0.2 satisfaction, using the existing mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 rather than creating a new reward account. Refresh requires a real applicable event at least 10 rounds apart; novelty is not required. Mere possession, idle work reservations and other people's presumed approval do not qualify. Basic nutrition and hunger costs remain unchanged by mood. Implement eligibility, caps, decay and deduplication in code, without recurrent model review.\",\"visualReview\":\"Evaluate visuals separately from manufacturing and experience. Emit observable collection, sample-bend/break, layout, paid weaving-step, pause, failure, completion, placement, sitting-trial, damage, repair and dismantling events only when they occur. Reusable metadata should identify item/workpiece ID, material/color derived from actual inputs, measured dimensions, weave density, stage, completed-step count, moisture, condition, loose edges, position, orientation and provenance-linked event ID. Show reserved loose fibers and incomplete weave distinctly from a finished mat. Failure displays broken strands or loose work, never a completed-mat icon or comfort effect. Completion follows the integrity check; comfort visualization follows an applicable actual sitting trial and stops when use or conditions cease. Do not render invented occupants, social approval, hidden material quality, insulation or successful repairs before verification.\"}]}"}
